symbolDescription: Every string the built-in components render or announce.

optionDescriptions.zoomIn: Accessible name of the zoom-in control.
optionDescriptions.zoomOut: Accessible name of the zoom-out control.
optionDescriptions.rotateLeft: Accessible name of the rotate-left control.
optionDescriptions.rotateRight: Accessible name of the rotate-right control.
optionDescriptions.resetView: Accessible name of the reset-view control.
optionDescriptions.cluster: Accessible name of a cluster marker holding `count` pins.
optionDescriptions.north: Suffix for northern latitudes on graticule labels, as in 30°N.
optionDescriptions.south: Suffix for southern latitudes on graticule labels, as in 30°S.
optionDescriptions.east: Suffix for eastern longitudes on graticule labels, as in 90°E.
optionDescriptions.west: Suffix for western longitudes on graticule labels, as in 90°W.
